Test fonts, subsets of Noto Sans Regular (SIL Open Font License 1.1,
see OFL.txt), generated with fonttools pyftsubset from
https://fonts.google.com/noto (NotoSans-Regular.ttf):

- NotoSans-ascii.ttf — printable ASCII (U+0020–007E) + U+2026 "…"
- NotoSans-a.ttf     — U+0061 only
- NotoSans-b.ttf     — U+0062 only

The single-glyph fonts exercise font fallback: shaped text covering
both must be split into runs with different faces.
